versions.changelog:
apa-experiment-generator 2.0.0 brings major enhancements and broader support for psychology experiment paradigms with automated APA 7th edition Method section writing.

- Expanded support for multiple psychology domains: cognitive neuroscience, social, developmental/educational, and clinical paradigms.
- Automatically generates a complete APA 7th edition Method section (Participants, Design and Materials, Procedure, Data Analysis) in markdown format.
- Accepts core experimental details as input (research question, paradigm, variable design); outputs ready-to-use methods for papers and theses.
- Ensures standardized, objective academic writing style and includes example trial timing templates for each paradigm.
- Can append core Python experiment logic (OpenSesame/PsychoPy) if requested by the user.
- Updated triggers for easier access through various phrases (e.g., “帮我写 APA 方法”, “设计 Stroop 实验”).
